I will put two bags of NPK fertilizer on this plot because I own the land and last season the yield was better where I fertilized. I will also spread manure from my cattle, since I have kept animals for many years and the dung helps the soil. I will plant my own saved sorghum seed, not the new hybrid types, because I trust what I know and I intercrop it with cowpea. My family will work about ninety days on this plot, and I will hire extra hands for twelve days at harvest time when the work is too heavy for us.
